## Summary: Shutdown / Lifecycle Chain

The critical shutdown path flows through:

```
Server.Shutdown()                          (server/server.go:134)
  -> s.Store.Close()                       (server/server.go:146)  -- *Store
       -> s.instanceSettingCache.Close()   (store/store.go:74)     -- *Cache
       -> s.userCache.Close()              (store/store.go:75)     -- *Cache
       -> s.userSettingCache.Close()       (store/store.go:76)     -- *Cache
       -> s.driver.Close()                 (store/store.go:78)     -- Driver interface -> *DB.Close() in sqlite/postgres/mysql
  -> s.sseHub.Close()                      (server/server.go:206)  -- *SSEHub
  -> s.httpServer.Close()                  (server/server.go:216)  -- *http.Server (fallback)
```

All other `.Close()` calls are standard library resource cleanup (`*os.File`, `*sql.Rows`, `http.Response.Body`, `net.Conn`, `io.WriteCloser`) in request-scoped or utility code.
